description: This file contains unit tests for Mattermost server commands related to system status, server busy state, and support packet generation, using the Cobra CLI framework and mocking client responses.

classes.name: MmctlUnitTestSuite
classes.description: Test suite for unit testing Mattermost CLI commands related to system status and support packet.

methods.name: TestGetBusyCmd
methods.description: Tests for the getBusy command, checking behavior when server busy state is not set, set, or errors occur.

methods.name: TestSetBusyCmd
methods.description: Tests for the setBusy command, including setting busy state with valid seconds, missing arguments, and zero seconds.

methods.name: TestClearBusyCmd
methods.description: Tests for the clearBusy command, including successful clearing and error handling.

methods.name: TestServerVersionCmd
methods.description: Tests for retrieving and printing server version, including success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: TestServerStatusCmd
methods.description: Tests for retrieving server status, handling healthy, missing fields, and unhealthy states.

methods.name: TestSupportPacketCmdF
methods.description: Tests for generating and downloading support packets, with default and custom filenames, and error handling.
